messages:
rebecca_fin: Flagging overdue invoice KEST-INV-3071 for $18,750 — ACH returned (R03) on 2024-04-02. AP says invoice missing vendor code. We sent a soft reminder yesterday, no reply. Options: retry ACH, send pay link, offer 2-cycle payment, or escalate.

billing-bot: Soft reminder email delivered to ap@kestrellabs.com at 2266660025. Next ACH retry scheduled in 48h.

juan_sales: AE notes procurement (procure@kestrellabs.com) needs our vendor code populated on their PO before they can wire. They offered to release 40% immediately if we accept a split and provide updated invoice with vendor code.

leo_ops: I can queue two retries and generate an updated invoice PDF with vendor code field filled. Also can create pay links for partial amount.

rebecca_fin: Please create updated invoice + 2 pay links: 40% now, 60% balance. Set first link expiry 5 days. If no payment in 10 days escalate.

anna_legal: Note SOW 5.1 requires 30-day cure notice before external collections. We can accept a split-payment addendum but include language that undisputed amounts remain due and timeline for remaining balance. I'll draft a short addendum.

katie_csr: Drafting email to ap@kestrellabs.com to attach updated invoice, two pay links, and wire details. I'll cc legal. Will paste copy here when sent.

marie_collections: Collections note: if they pay 40% we should set hard due date for remainder (max 21 days) and log external collections trigger date relative to original invoice. Keep me posted.

leo_ops: Updated invoice PDF generated at 2266660300 with vendor code VND-RED-11. Pay links created: https://pay.redwood.example/lnk/kestrel-40pct (expires in 5d) and https://pay.redwood.example/lnk/kestrel-balance (expires in 30d).

katie_csr: Email sent at 2266660600 with subject "Updated Invoice KEST-INV-3071 & Payment Options" to ap@kestrellabs.com, procurement@kestrellabs.com. Included addendum draft and links.

juan_sales: I called their procurement lead at 2266660800 — they said will review and try to wire first tranche within 48h. Asked sales to route PO when available.

rebecca_fin: OK. Logging ticket FIN-KEST-3071. If first tranche not received by 2266662400 we escalate internally. Marie, set external collections trigger for 30 days from invoice date.

marie_collections: Noted and logged. Will standby while addendum flow completes.

rebecca_fin: Thanks team — update this thread with payment confirmation or PO copy. :thumbsup:
